'''Troida Corporation''' was one of the major companies operated on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]; Headed by Director [[Fenn (Balmorran)|Fenn]], they made a deal with the [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]] to join the [[Balmorran resistance]].
